Thank you to Steve Hopkins, our 2025 Virginia Farmer of the Year, and his entire team for welcoming us to the farm today. Hearing how they’re using advanced AI systems, ranging from mapping harvest routes to precisely climate-controlling the turkey houses, even sensing when someone new enters the building by detecting the slight change in humidity from the door opening. It was truly amazing. The innovations and technologies driving modern agriculture are remarkable, and they're a powerful reminder that just 2% of our population can feed the other 98%. Grateful for hardworking farm families like the Hopkins who keep America running.
